_comment: Project-level config override -- shallow-merged on top of pipeline_config.json + channel_dna by config_loader.load_config(scripts_dir, project_dir). Etiolation_S1 is a listicle; item_overlay_enabled defaults to false (narrative) in pipeline_config.json, so this project flips it on here rather than changing the shared default. See stitch_video_longform.py's build_item_overlay_windows()/add_item_number_overlay() and CLAUDE.md's BACKLOG entry on config_loader's project-override layer.
